project.title: Standardized Interior Renovation Pilot for Office Floor
project.objective: Plan and execute a fast, safe interior renovation of one office floor using standardized methods and checklists.
deliverables: Completed renovation of pilot office floor (walls, ceilings, basic finishes)
Standard work method checklist for recurring interior renovation tasks
Daily safety and quality inspection log for the pilot floor
Material and tools list optimized for repeatable interior jobs
Post-project review with improvement actions for next floors
constraints: Work must be done during defined daytime windows to limit noise
Strict adherence to health and safety procedures in construction
Use only pre-approved building materials and tools
No structural changes allowed, only interior finishes and fittings
Waste must be separated and disposed of following site rules

risks.risk: Noise and dust disturbing nearby occupied areas during renovation.
risks.mitigation: Plan noisy tasks in tight time windows, use dust barriers and extraction, and communicate schedule in advance.

risks.risk: Delays due to missing or late delivery of materials and tools.
risks.mitigation: Create detailed material list upfront, check stock two days ahead, and keep small buffer of common items on site.

risks.risk: Accidents or near-misses from improper use of equipment or PPE.
risks.mitigation: Reinforce safety briefing, daily PPE checks, and quick reporting of unsafe conditions with corrective actions.

risks.risk: Rework caused by poor surface preparation before painting or tiling.
risks.mitigation: Introduce mandatory surface inspection checklist and photo proof before finishing work starts.

themes.why_relevant: Workers handle heavy equipment, dust, and heights; consistent PPE and safe methods are critical.
Repeatable interior tasks benefit from clear steps and checklists to reduce errors and rework.
Drywall, plastering, painting, and tiling must be sequenced to avoid blocking each other and wasting time.
Having the right materials and tools on time prevents idle time and rushed unsafe work.
Early detection of defects in surfaces and finishes avoids late rework and missed deadlines.

backlog.task: Survey existing office floor and document current wall, ceiling, and floor conditions
definition_of_done: All rooms and corridors inspected and noted
Photos taken of damaged or irregular areas
Findings recorded in the site survey sheet
Survey shared in channel and acknowledged by team

backlog.task: Prepare walls and ceilings for plastering and painting on pilot floor
definition_of_done: Old loose material removed and surfaces cleaned
Cracks and holes filled and sanded where needed
Moisture or structural issues flagged in log
Area signed off in preparation checklist

backlog.task: Install and align drywall and construction profiles for new partition walls
definition_of_done: Profiles installed according to layout marks
Drywall fixed securely with correct spacing
Joints taped and ready for finishing
Measurements checked against plan and logged

backlog.task: Apply plaster and finish surfaces ready for painting
definition_of_done: Plaster applied evenly on all designated surfaces
No visible bumps or holes after drying and sanding
Edges and corners straight and clean
Quality check recorded with photos in log

backlog.task: Paint walls and ceilings according to specified color scheme
definition_of_done: Surfaces masked and protected before painting
Required number of coats applied with no streaks
No paint on floors, windows, or fittings
Final painted areas approved in quality checklist

backlog.task: Lay tiles in designated pantry and restroom areas
definition_of_done: Subfloor checked for level and cleaned
Tiles cut and laid with consistent joints
Grout applied and excess cleaned off
Slopes and transitions verified and logged

backlog.task: Install roof windows or ceiling access panels where required
definition_of_done: Openings measured and marked correctly
Units installed per manufacturer instructions
Sealing and insulation checked
Installation recorded with photos in log

backlog.task: Create and refine standard interior renovation checklist for recurring tasks
definition_of_done: Key steps for drywall, plaster, paint, and tiling listed
Safety and quality checks included for each step
Checklist tested on at least one room
Team feedback collected and final version saved

backlog.task: Set up daily safety and tool inspection routine for the pilot floor
definition_of_done: List of PPE and tools to inspect defined
Simple daily form created and shared
Routine followed for at least one week
Any issues and fixes recorded in log

backlog.task: Coordinate material deliveries and on-site storage for the pilot
definition_of_done: Material list by task and date prepared
Delivery times confirmed with site contact
Storage area organized and labeled
No workday lost due to missing materials

backlog.task: Maintain daily progress and issue log for the renovation
definition_of_done: Daily entries for completed tasks recorded
Delays or issues noted with short cause
Photos attached for key milestones
Log reviewed in weekly check-in

backlog.task: Conduct post-project review and propose improvements for next floors
definition_of_done: What worked well and what did not documented
Safety, quality, and timing observations listed
At least five concrete improvement actions proposed
Review shared and agreed in channel

artifacts.title: Pilot Floor Site Survey Sheet
artifacts.used_for: Capture initial condition of walls, ceilings, and floors with notes and photos.

artifacts.title: Interior Renovation Standard Work Checklist
artifacts.used_for: Guide workers through standard steps for drywall, plastering, painting, and tiling.

artifacts.title: Daily Safety and Tool Inspection Form
artifacts.used_for: Record PPE, tool condition, and any unsafe conditions before work starts.

artifacts.title: Material and Tool Planning List
artifacts.used_for: Plan quantities and delivery dates for materials and tools per task.

artifacts.title: Daily Progress and Issue Log
artifacts.used_for: Track completed work, delays, and issues with short comments and photos.

artifacts.title: Surface Preparation and Quality Guideline
artifacts.used_for: Explain how to prepare and inspect surfaces before finishing to avoid rework.

artifacts.title: Noise, Dust, and Waste Control Rules
artifacts.used_for: Define how to limit disturbance, manage dust, and separate construction waste.

artifacts.title: Post-Project Review Notes
artifacts.used_for: Summarize lessons learned and improvement actions for future floors.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on scope, constraints, and sequence for the pilot floor renovation.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message announcing the pilot and asking for input on plan and order of tasks.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm final sequence of main tasks (survey, prep, drywall, plaster, paint, tiling).
Agree which rooms and areas are included in the pilot floor scope.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define and lock the standard work checklist and safety routine.
threads_plan.trigger: Message sharing first draft of checklists and asking for quick review and edits.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the interior renovation standard work checklist for use on the pilot.
Decide the exact time and responsible person for daily safety and tool checks.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate material deliveries, storage, and readiness for each task.
threads_plan.trigger: Message flagging upcoming tasks and asking to confirm material availability.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm delivery dates and times for drywall, plaster, paint, and tiles.
Choose the on-site storage area and rules for organizing materials.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Track daily progress, handle issues, and adjust plan if needed.
threads_plan.trigger: First daily update post asking everyone to share what was done and blockers.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on simple daily update format and who posts the summary.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Run post-project review and lock improvement actions for next floors.
threads_plan.trigger: Message after pilot completion asking for lessons learned and suggestions.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Select which improvement actions will be mandatory for the next renovation floor.

channel_rituals: Daily short async standup with what was done, plan for next day, and blockers.
Weekly planning post to confirm tasks, materials, and safety focus for the coming week.
End-of-phase check when finishing each major step (prep, drywall, plaster, paint, tiling).
Post-project review thread to capture lessons learned and agree on improvements.
